Rig layout reference data
Author: CA

Reference reviewed: 10 October 2026
105 rig variants: 76 position records from tarkov.dev and 29 supplemental records checked against local game UI geometry.
Wiki references: https://escapefromtarkov.fandom.com/wiki/Chest_rigs
The Wiki layout images are used as references only and are not included in this dataset.
Tarkov game assets and original screenshots belong to Battlestate Games and are not included in this dataset.
Only numerical pocket positions and dimensions are included.
No installed game files are required by the application.

Supplemental positions were checked against UI/rig layouts in a read-only local game snapshot.
Snapshot SHA256: 64921d40e5d6e0672c441a52d2dc293262d11ff94406643245e6d8c9c0b990f5

tarkov.dev source:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/the-hideout/tarkov-dev/b651b15bc3819f6b7360e11dea7f1adcedc50837/src/data/item-grids.json
Source SHA256: 779c359de79dff3691d8c12cf92901214af50d30f611d143b3cff8e2d6014969

The upstream 6B45 Assault layout duplicated one pocket position. Its own game UI layout is used to correct that entry.

Backpacks: 47 layouts. 37 single rectangular grids from the saved item export; 10 multi-pocket position records from the same pinned tarkov.dev item-grids source above.
